name: gopeed-extension-weibo-video
author: weibo-downloader
title: Weibo Media Downloader
description: Auto-parse Weibo videos, image posts, Live Photos, mixed posts (tv/show, video.weibo.com, t.cn, status links), and direct weibocdn.com / sinaimg.cn links into Gopeed tasks with Referer header and quality selection.

settings.name: quality
settings.title: Preferred Quality
settings.description: Select the preferred video resolution, or list all available qualities in Gopeed.

settings.name: livePhoto
settings.title: Live Photo Mode
settings.description: How to handle Weibo Live Photos in image posts.

settings.name: cookie
settings.title: Weibo Cookie (Optional, for Private / 4K)
settings.description: Optional. Paste your Weibo Cookie header or SUB value from browser DevTools to access private, follower-only, VIP, or 1080p/4K videos. Leave blank for automatic guest access on public posts.

settings.name: userAgent
settings.title: Custom User-Agent (Optional)
settings.description: Optional custom User-Agent override. Leave blank to use the default modern Desktop Chrome User-Agent.
